scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/frontend && cd apps/backend && ./mvnw package
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:infra && npm run setup:backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/frontend && cd apps/backend && ./mvnw test
